description:
## Return YouTube Username v2.2.5

- Fix AbstractPreferenceFragment Toast Error: Hooked ApplicationInitHook & ApplicationInitOnCreateHook so ReturnYouTubeUsernamePatch is initialized early on app launch, pre-registering all settings keys into Morphe's Setting registry and eliminating 'Preference key has no setting' toasts.
- Fix Channel Profile Handle Replacement: Added lockup_metadata, metadata_content, and bottom_sheet to exclusion filters, preventing the channel's @handle beneath the channel name from being redundantly replaced with the channel name.
- Cleaned up unused legacy setting fields.
- Pure Standalone Morphe Patch Bundle (~20 KB): Fully compatible with Morphe 2.1.0+ and YouTube 21.30.216.
